containerVersion.name: Meta transport cleanup – direct Pixel + canonical CAPI

tag.name: Conversion Linker
tag.notes: Initialize only with marketing consent; re-evaluate on cookie_consent_update. URL passthrough stays inactive while consent is pending or denied.

tag.name: Canonical Google tag - GT-MKRLF5WK
tag.notes: Base config only; a consented canonical page_view initializes Google immediately before event delivery. send_page_view remains false.

tag.name: GA4 – Canonical ecommerce events
tag.notes: Canonical ecommerce adapter only. page_view, search and generate_lead are handled by non-ecommerce tags.

tag.name: Microsoft Clarity - Official
tag.notes: Load at most once per page. All Pages handles stored consent; cookie_consent_update handles first-page grant.

tag.name: Base Tag(UET 97247724)
tag.notes: Loads once only after marketing consent and a canonical ID Sync VID are ready. Initial browser pageLoad is then associated with the consented session.

tag.name: Microsoft UET – Canonical business events
tag.notes: Official native Microsoft UET business adapter. CanonicalEvent action, event_id deduplication, value/currency, and dynamic remarketing parameters.

tag.name: GA4 – Canonical page_view
tag.notes: Canonical page_view adapter. The application releases the retained event after consent with the original event_id; one exact canonical trigger owns GA4 delivery.

tag.name: GA4 – Canonical non-commerce events
tag.notes: Canonical search and generate_lead adapter. Ecommerce payload disabled.

tag.name: Meta – Pixel – Canonical browser parity
tag.notes: LandingScrollDepth via trackSingleCustom; CUSTOM_EVENTS classification. Exact eventID = canonical event_id. GTM/app source SHA-256 01d26431d6afefd044d8e2a7e83784f4bf0ef6476bb20ebe2200e03723462f0d. App-owned same-origin fallback polls every 200 ms; both owners share __utekosMetaPixelState and sent keys. Tag itself fail-closes on Cookiebot marketing consent.

    w.addEventListener('CookiebotOnDecline', retry);
  }

  function startPolling() {
    if (state.poller !== null) return;

    state.poller = w.setInterval(function() {
      run();
    }, 200);
  }

  listenForConsent();
  run();
  startPolling();
})(window, document);
</script>
